title: IncidentPlaybook
description: Remediation playbook produced by diagnostic-service, served by `GET /playbook/{playbook_id}` and persisted as one JSON file per playbook under PLAYBOOK_STORE_DIR (docs/CONTRACTS.md §3). Always produced: when the LLM fails or LLM_PROVIDER=none, `generated_by` is `fallback:rule-based`.

playbook_id.description: `pb-<component_id>-<8 hex>`. Also the file name stem in the playbook store, so it must be validated against this pattern before any file-system access.

alert_id.description: Linked PredictiveAlert (REQ-I); null for on-demand diagnoses.

steps.description: Ranked remediation steps (REQ-H). Ranks are 1..n, contiguous, unique and in ascending order (rank of item i == i+1); JSON Schema cannot fully express that, so consumers/tests must also check it.

command.description: Suggested command or action. Advisory only: never executed by the platform.
